inputs.ideas: work_space2/ab-v041/ideas.md (10 fixed ideas, identical text to ab-v04)

execution.concurrencyNote: The runner exits(2) on any concurrency other than 1. The previous batch used 2 and overlapped 1.95x, which made its wall-clock column meaningless (retracted in the previous baseline).
execution.cacheEvidence: runner clears $DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-find-ideas before every run and records cacheBeforeRun.remaining in each metrics row; all 20 rows record remaining=0.
execution.sessionBinding: Every metrics row carries the sessionId of the run that produced it; payload and wall-clock are re-derived from that session's durable log, never from the --json stream.

evidence: feasibility.json: absolute lower bound 29123.47 at the measured prompt floor (11697.1 tokens) with context held constant, which is 16.5% over target
floor-profile.json: structural floor band 25110.65 (linear, an under-estimate) to 28803.08 (payload-preserving, defensible), both over target
payload-elasticity.json: even if inspect_projects returned nothing, billed reaches only 25757.74
wall-decompose.json: 7.40 steps x 6796.36ms of model time = 50293ms with all tool latency set to zero

differencesFromAbV04.impact: Largest non-comparability. Arm A went from 8.8 to 13.4 calls; 8 of 10 runs used 14 or more, 4 hit the ceiling exactly. Absolute billed for both arms rose; only B/A ratios are interpretable across batches.
The previous batch overlapped 1.95x, so its wall clock was not wall clock. That column was retracted in the previous baseline.
Card copy and trim notice changed, so payload is not byte-comparable across batches.
This batch measures the combined effect of four optimisation rounds, not any single one.

notes: Payload numbers come from durable session logs, not `dsh --json` (8192B clip under-reported the previous batch by 6-42%; the projection ratio here is 0.58-0.94).
Quality = mean of 2 raters x 4 dimensions, 16-point scale. Rubric was re-derived for this batch; only the within-batch A-vs-B delta is meaningful.
The quality raters were separate agents given only rubric.md and blind-v041/*.md; blind-v041-map.json maps tags back to (id, arm) and was withheld from them.
quality-v041.json embeds both raters' raw per-dimension scores and reasons, so inter-rater agreement is recomputable without the original rater files; those are kept anyway as the audit trail.
Metrics rows retain the full raw counters (inputTokens, cacheReadTokens, steps, toolCalls, sessionId), so every published mean is recomputable from the frozen files alone.
